visualReview.notes: All13 final portable views actually inspected in six combined contact sheets, including overview/four turntables and eight architecture/site details. Final portable/shared capture refresh after a verification-script-only edit produced byte-identical image hashes to the inspected frames. No black-painted substitute for the open court; all16 gunports and facade apertures have modeled depth/rear surfaces. Four individually inspected local Qualla originals and44 contact thumbnails, supplemented by four official heritage photographs (north/east entrance, south aerial, complete river facade and west bastion). Native16 building parts constrain tower, separate polygonal bastion, foundation, east landing and real court hole. Retains north central paired balcony/paired upper window and single upper chapel arch; south seven-arch loggia/crossed rail, separate two upper balconied arches/royal arms and blank upper chapel wall. Hanging fluted domed bartizans, beaded finials, projecting machicolated walk, Christ-cross shield merlons, pointed upper battlements, pierced quatrefoil court rail/pinnacles and Madonna/Child canopy are recognizable medium-fi interpretations. Fine carved relief, faces, inscriptions, heraldic detail and the rhinoceros carving are generalized or omitted; no copied photograph pixels.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All13 final shared views actually inspected; full south loggia, court, bartizan and original-terrain bridge view additionally inspected. Three shared graphs (limestone, marble, wood) and two local palette finishes retain pale stone, restrained coursing and dark steel. Isolated stage adjusted to meet the foundation bottom; independent terrain never edited. Native heading/anchor and map outline overlay checked in placement frame; hide/unload restores ground. Flat shared stage is an isolated material/plan check, not a tidal survey.

mediumFiReview.notes: All25 final original-field context views actually inspected: street/block/skyline, noon/late, economy/high, silhouette, eight detail views and four explicit LOD transitions. All frame asset/runtime/LOD identities verified. Exact original source coordinates remain unchanged; both terrain and distant backdrop are clipped only at physical foundation outline.225 actual rendered ground probes report no ground covering the opening. Synthetic neighboring houses are review context, not the Lisbon coastline.

bridge.basis: Deck across width above retained source field;12mm planks and slope-joint overlap included. Photo-directed route/width remain approximate.

geographicReview.notes: Native upper tower width12.0692m, heading−0.174672rad and mapped court/foundation/terrace parts are retained. Anchor comes from actual tower body, not the south-shifted article coordinate. Original256m Terrarium field was frozen before geometry and fully reproduced from two original PNGs; external dry promenade datum5.1389m and offshore provider0m reference are explicit. Bridge L-plan is photographic, joining mapped east landing and unchanged shore sample. No surveyed tidal datum, bathymetry or default coarse terrain compatibility claim. Replacement disabled.

runtimeLodReview.notes: 980/3970/14999/54259 actual authored/runtime triangles;1/6/6/6 draws. Strict budgets, geometry/normals/UV/winding, native foundation/court Float32 positions,4251 half-metre physical coverage points and321 bridge samples per LOD pass. Open court retained even at skyline; district omits small decoration, skyline omits window/gunport recess detail by design. Sampled controls do not certify complete manifold topology or walkable interiors.

fidelityReview.notes: Exact August Dominus CC0 originals confirm the pale square tower beside a separate low polygonal bastion, sloping waterline base, hanging fluted domed bartizans with finials, machicolated walk, shield merlons, paired north balcony/window hierarchy and pointed upper battlements. Current whole, north, west-bastion and bartizan renders retain these identifying masses and relationships. Both photographs show the same aspect and are not represented as all-around coverage. The opposite loggia, open court, bridge/landing and concealed junctions remain explicitly approximate mapped/architectural forms; fine carving, heraldry and masonry courses remain generalized. River/shore scenery, temporary lighting and interiors are excluded. Accepted at the agreed approximate medium-fi exterior scope. No reference pixels are embedded. Previously used attribution/private imagery is excluded from this current review.

validation.sourceHeightPolicy: Original provider heights retained; public physical-ground controller modifies only rendered mesh while model visible.

limitations: Native map is quantized; mapped height fields are relative building annotations, not surveyed architectural or tidal elevations.
Current article coordinate is south of the tower body; anchor derived from actual native tower polygon.
Approach bridge is a photo-directed approximate plan; native vector extract does not contain its complete route. No surveyed bridge dimensions or tidal elevations.

Foundation toe flares5.5percent below the native upper foundation edge; north podium and masonry courses follow photographic interpretation. Mapped29m body/30m parapet exclude interpreted bartizan domes/finials, extending to32.7m above provider-water control. Aperture heights, sculpture and ornament are conservative photographic interpretations, not measured drawings.

The bridge L-plan is constrained by the official aerial/entrance photos and mapped east landing; route, structural spans and widths are approximate. Endpoint meets unchanged source shore field. No engineered bridge, interiors, navigable collision or operating tide/water simulation.
Original Terrarium pixels may oversample coarser composite DEM;1m sampling is not survey resolution. Default coarse world terrain is not certified.

Fine Manueline/figurative carving is generalized or omitted at this medium-fi scale; model is not an architectural conservation/survey replica. Bridge plan/sections and foundation toe are photo interpretations.

River, tide, city/promenance and submarine bed are outside model scope. Original composite DEM may include interpolated urban surfaces; source-relative compatibility is not global terrain certification.
